name: Direct molecular operation
description: Represent what the target itself does: chemical transformation, binding, translocation or physical energy effect; distinguish a downstream consequence.
claim_scope: A specified protein/complex acting on material in a stated preparation and condition; the operation may remain unresolved while a narrower binding claim is retained.
distinctions: Target-executed step versus spontaneous or partner-executed consequence.
Model-substrate activity versus solved native function.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: A positive assay does not establish primary native role.
An incomplete preparation or inappropriate condition does not establish universal inactivity.
A downstream product does not identify each enzyme-executed step.
boundary: A02 specifies material/features selected; A03 specifies how action works; A06 specifies system responsibility. These are independently representable.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Primary Results and Discussion plus alignment and assay descriptions inspected through indexed full-text sections. No sequence alignment or experiments rerun here.
evidence.observation: Controlled negative cyclohydrolase assays and authentic preQ1 product assign nitrile reduction while retaining the pathway association.
evidence.limit: Author assays; no universal transfer to every FolE-like protein.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Primary sequence-analysis methods/results, abstract and product-analysis conclusion inspected; no new sequence search or biochemical experiment.
evidence.observation: Product analysis assigns phosphorylation; observed alkene follows spontaneous decomposition, not direct enzyme decarboxylation.
evidence.limit: Sequence sections and product-analysis conclusion inspected; no new experiment.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Full primary text and live 1MJH contact record checked; published answer known.
evidence.observation: ATP binding, absent appreciable purified-alone hydrolysis and extract-enabled hydrolysis require different annotation claims.
evidence.limit: Activating extract component and cellular role remain unidentified.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: 2013 main narrative, modeling assumptions and stated assay outcomes inspected; detailed supplementary assay protocols not independently checked. 2019 complete relevant activity/results/discussion and assay conditions inspected. Original 2011 paper not newly verified.
evidence.observation: Measured model-ester hydrolysis is narrower than a solved native function, particularly with weak kinetic parameters and explicit author qualification.
evidence.limit: 2019 relevant body inspected; original 2011 PDC claim was not independently reverified.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Complete relevant mutant/spectroscopy/growth Results and growth conditions. No new fluorescence-lifetime analysis.
evidence.observation: C260V removes excitation quenching, supporting physical energy dissipation rather than assigning a new enzymatic reaction.
evidence.limit: Author spectroscopy; no new lifetime analysis or universal phenotype claim.
